description: This file defines a middleware class for handling exceptions in an ASP.NET Core application, converting exceptions into JSON error responses.

classes.name: ExceptionMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware for catching exceptions during request processing and returning formatted JSON error responses.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Main middleware method that invokes the next request delegate and handles exceptions.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Handles exceptions, sets appropriate HTTP status codes, and writes error details as JSON response.
